scope: Chinese-to-English title correspondence and title-localization evaluation only
limitations: The selected source records do not include Chinese synopsis, genre, or original-platform URL.
They must not be used with workflows that require those fields.

split.algorithm: exclude legacy V0 pilot IDs and pre-freeze audit rejections; sort eligible pair IDs by SHA-256(seed:pair_id); take first 100

pre_freeze_rejections.reason: Chinese/English author conflict in title mapping audit

normalization.method: Latin-1 mojibake decoded as GB18030 only when the result contains CJK characters; leading BOM removed

semantic_title_author_audit.method: Per-record Chinese/English title and author review; localized rather than literal English titles are accepted when they identify the same work.

review_basis: Chinese and English title semantic correspondence reviewed
